messages:
Maya: heads up — new users hitting the samplekit quickstart in json+streaming mode. sampleapp sends a function call payload and the SDK helper ends up emitting a trailing comma in the final chunk, which breaks strict schema validation on the server side. repro steps below.

Maya: repro (node):
```js
const client = new RedwoodSDK({ jsonMode: true, streaming: true });
await client.chat.complete({
  model: 'open-ish',
  messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'call tool' }],
  functions: [{ name: 'calc', parameters: { type: 'object', properties: { x: { type: 'number' } }, required: ['x'] } }]
});
```

Maya: logs from local:
```
receiving chunk: '{"name":"calc","arguments":{"x":42}},'
final assembled json: '{"name":"calc","arguments":{"x":42}},'
schema validation error: Unexpected token , in JSON at position 34
```

Maya: this only shows up in the samplekit onboarding flow when streaming is on. Py SDK users seem fine (reported by a partner) — maybe a parity issue in the JS helper that joins chunks.

Sam: hmm, thanks. can you paste which SDK version and whether this is the samplekit shipped in cloud or local dev?

Maya: js-sdk@0.7.2, samplekit v0.14. deployed locally via `npm run start-local`.

Sam: looks like the helper that concatenates streaming tokens appends a literal comma to separate function metadata when it expects more actions. if the server closes immediately after function object, helper shouldn't leave a trailing comma.

Liam: sounds like a state machine bug in the streaming serializer. py-sdk probably uses a tolerant incremental parser; js-sdk was trying to be strict.

Maya: short-term workaround I pushed to my fork: post-process assembled string with `s.replace(/,\s*\}$/,'}')` before json.parse. ugly but fixes onboarding bootcamp.

Jen: onboarding impact = high. Bootcamp students hit this at least 3x today, blocks them from running sample workflows. can we get a hotfix? tagging eng-runtime and devex.

Sam: agreed. i'll own a patch. quick triage: 1) reproduce with unit test for streaming termination, 2) add a guard to serializer to only inject comma if next token expected, 3) add a regression test comparing JS <> Py outputs.

Maya: thanks. added a minimal failing test case and opened a draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samplekit/pull/189 (WIP)

ci-bot: deploy pipeline — samplekit-staging build #422 succeeded (logs: https://ci.internal/samplekit/422)

Sam: nice. i'll review the PR later today. also propose adding a loose-mode option (jsonMode: 'loose') for onboarding that tolerates trailing commas so new users aren't blocked until patch lands. thoughts?

Liam: fine as temporary opt-in, but we should not ship loose mode as default. also add an integration test that runs the bootcamp script.

Jen: agree. please treat this as P1 for next sprint planning if we can't fix in patch window.

Maya: appreciated. leaving my debug logs in the PR and a tiny sample script to reproduce. will update if I find more flakes. :thumbsup:
